nodes.description: Internal view helper that builds price from 1e36, multiplies by the aggregator 'multiply' rate (or 1e18), divides by the aggregator 'divide' rate and finally by 'decimals'.
Pure helper returning abi.encode(multiply, divide, decimals) for oracle data parameter construction.
Public state-reading oracle entrypoint; abi.decodes caller supplied data into (multiply, divide, decimals) and returns (true, _get(...)).
View oracle entrypoint; abi.decodes caller supplied data and returns (true, _get(...)).
View oracle entrypoint delegating to peek(data) and returning only the rate.
Returns the constant string 'Chainlink'.
Returns the constant string 'LINK'.
External Chainlink aggregator call returning an int256 answer; invoked on caller supplied addresses.

Checked uint256 multiplication with overflow require.

price.mul(IAggregator(multiply).latestAnswer()) in _get; attacker influenced multiplicand can push arithmetic bounds.
price / uint256(IAggregator(divide).latestAnswer()) in _get; unchecked division, zero answer reverts and divisor is attacker controlled.
price / decimals in _get; unchecked division by caller supplied decimals (zero reverts).
External call IAggregator(multiply).latestAnswer() to a caller supplied address.
External call IAggregator(divide).latestAnswer() to a caller supplied address.

peek() calls the internal _get() helper to compute the rate.

The oracle division is executed inside _get().

The external divide-aggregator call originates from _get().

abi.decode is executed inside peek().

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter multiply only exists as an argument of _get() and has no standalone semantics.
Parameter divide only exists as an argument of _get() and has no standalone semantics.
Parameter decimals is exclusively the divisor of the final unchecked division.
Calldata parameter data belongs to get() and is only consumed by its abi.decode.
Calldata parameter data belongs to peek() and is only consumed by its abi.decode.
First arithmetic operand is only meaningful inside the checked math helper.
Second arithmetic operand is only meaningful inside the checked math helper.
Local price accumulator is the operand of the price multiplication inside _get().
Decoded multiply address exists only as the output of the calldata decode.
Decoded divide address exists only as the output of the calldata decode.
